text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahahahahaー! It's a grand victory for 
Windy-chan~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was looking this way! They 
praised me and said I was fast!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! How's that, how's that!! This is 
what Windy-chan is all about!!
choice_data_list: Let's give it even more effort!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nishishishi! Right? Right?! Windy-chan is 
the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Finally, everyone's realized how amazing 
Windy-chan is, da noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah! I'll win the next one too 
and steal the spotlight~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...! Windy-chan won! I already did my 
best!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And yet, why would you say such a 
thing...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"You've got some nerve! Prepare yourself, 
nanoda!!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna take a big bite out of you~!!
